description: Pins the B2B member-vault-key derivation (derive_person_vault_member_key: Argon2id over the normalized phrase under salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-vault-member|' with the vault account_number_hash in the salt slot) and the member-key-store AAD (aad_person_member_key_store: 'person-member-key-store' role, vault_id || account_number_hash, v0.2 prefix). A port that frames either differently derives a key that opens nothing, or an AAD that fails every open. EXPECTED RUNTIME: ~3s (Argon2id at canonical params). Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_person_member_key_store_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored`.
